communication_templates_approval_check.name: communication_templates_approval_check
communication_templates_approval_check.value: ("communication_templates"."status" = 'approved') = ("communication_templates"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "communication_templates"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

crm_contacts_merge_check.name: crm_contacts_merge_check
crm_contacts_merge_check.value: ("crm_contacts"."status" = 'merged') = ("crm_contacts"."merged_into_id" IS NOT NULL AND "crm_contacts"."merged_at" IS NOT NULL)

events_cfp_times_check.name: events_cfp_times_check
events_cfp_times_check.value: (("events"."cfp_opens_at" is null and "events"."cfp_closes_at" is null) or ("events"."cfp_opens_at" is not null and "events"."cfp_closes_at" is not null and "events"."cfp_closes_at">"events"."cfp_opens_at"))

cfp_form_fields_file_check.name: cfp_form_fields_file_check
cfp_form_fields_file_check.value: ("cfp_form_fields"."kind"='file_request' and "cfp_form_fields"."file_owner" in('submission','participant') and "cfp_form_fields"."allowed_mime_types_json" is not null and "cfp_form_fields"."max_bytes">0) or ("cfp_form_fields"."kind"<>'file_request' and "cfp_form_fields"."file_owner" is null and "cfp_form_fields"."allowed_mime_types_json" is null and "cfp_form_fields"."max_bytes" is null)

evaluation_scores_one_value_check.name: evaluation_scores_one_value_check
evaluation_scores_one_value_check.value: ("evaluation_scores"."value_number" IS NOT NULL) <> ("evaluation_scores"."value_text" IS NOT NULL)

evaluation_scores_origin_check.name: evaluation_scores_origin_check
evaluation_scores_origin_check.value: ("evaluation_scores"."origin" = 'human' AND "evaluation_scores"."suggestion_id" IS NULL AND "evaluation_scores"."suggestion_status" IS NULL) OR ("evaluation_scores"."origin" = 'ai' AND "evaluation_scores"."suggestion_id" IS NOT NULL AND "evaluation_scores"."suggestion_status" IS NOT NULL)

review_assignments_lineage_check.name: review_assignments_lineage_check
review_assignments_lineage_check.value: ("review_assignments"."predecessor_assignment_id" IS NULL OR "review_assignments"."predecessor_assignment_id" <> "review_assignments"."id") AND ("review_assignments"."successor_assignment_id" IS NULL OR "review_assignments"."successor_assignment_id" <> "review_assignments"."id")

review_assignments_superseded_check.name: review_assignments_superseded_check
review_assignments_superseded_check.value: ("review_assignments"."status" = 'superseded') = ("review_assignments"."superseded_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "review_assignments"."superseded_at" IS NOT NULL)

review_plans_grading_lock_check.name: review_plans_grading_lock_check
review_plans_grading_lock_check.value: "review_plans"."grading_locked_at" IS NULL OR "review_plans"."grading_revision" IS NOT NULL

review_rounds_time_check.name: review_rounds_time_check
review_rounds_time_check.value: "review_rounds"."closes_at" IS NULL OR "review_rounds"."opens_at" IS NULL OR "review_rounds"."closes_at" > "review_rounds"."opens_at"

agenda_suggestion_changes_shape_check.name: agenda_suggestion_changes_shape_check
agenda_suggestion_changes_shape_check.value: ("agenda_suggestion_changes"."kind" = 'add' AND "agenda_suggestion_changes"."before_json" IS NULL AND "agenda_suggestion_changes"."after_json" IS NOT NULL) OR ("agenda_suggestion_changes"."kind" = 'remove' AND "agenda_suggestion_changes"."before_json" IS NOT NULL AND "agenda_suggestion_changes"."after_json" IS NULL) OR ("agenda_suggestion_changes"."kind" IN ('move', 'change') AND "agenda_suggestion_changes"."before_json" IS NOT NULL AND "agenda_suggestion_changes"."after_json" IS NOT NULL)

agenda_suggestion_changes_json_check.name: agenda_suggestion_changes_json_check
agenda_suggestion_changes_json_check.value: ("agenda_suggestion_changes"."before_json" IS NULL OR (json_valid("agenda_suggestion_changes"."before_json") AND json_type("agenda_suggestion_changes"."before_json") = 'object')) AND ("agenda_suggestion_changes"."after_json" IS NULL OR (json_valid("agenda_suggestion_changes"."after_json") AND json_type("agenda_suggestion_changes"."after_json") = 'object'))

agenda_suggestion_runs_json_check.name: agenda_suggestion_runs_json_check
agenda_suggestion_runs_json_check.value: json_valid("agenda_suggestion_runs"."criteria_json") AND json_type("agenda_suggestion_runs"."criteria_json") = 'object' AND json_valid("agenda_suggestion_runs"."diff_json") AND json_type("agenda_suggestion_runs"."diff_json") = 'object' AND json_valid("agenda_suggestion_runs"."diagnostics_json") AND json_type("agenda_suggestion_runs"."diagnostics_json") = 'object' AND json_valid("agenda_suggestion_runs"."accepted_change_ids_json") AND json_type("agenda_suggestion_runs"."accepted_change_ids_json") = 'array' AND json_valid("agenda_suggestion_runs"."applied_change_ids_json") AND json_type("agenda_suggestion_runs"."applied_change_ids_json") = 'array'

agenda_suggestion_runs_terminal_check.name: agenda_suggestion_runs_terminal_check
agenda_suggestion_runs_terminal_check.value: (("agenda_suggestion_runs"."status" = 'rejected') = ("agenda_suggestion_runs"."rejected_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agenda_suggestion_runs"."rejected_by" IS NOT NULL)) AND (("agenda_suggestion_runs"."status" = 'applied') = ("agenda_suggestion_runs"."applied_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agenda_suggestion_runs"."applied_by" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("agenda_suggestion_runs"."status" <> 'superseded' OR "agenda_suggestion_runs"."superseded_at" IS NOT NULL)

program_publication_states_revisions_che.name: program_publication_states_revisions_check
program_publication_states_revisions_che.value: ("program_publication_states"."served_revision" IS NULL OR "program_publication_states"."served_revision">0) AND ("program_publication_states"."pending_revision" IS NULL OR "program_publication_states"."pending_revision">0)

program_releases_numbers_check.name: program_releases_numbers_check
program_releases_numbers_check.value: "program_releases"."revision">0 AND "program_releases"."agenda_revision_number">0 AND "program_releases"."speaker_revision_number">0 AND "program_releases"."approved_content_revision">=0 AND "program_releases"."approved_profile_revision">=0 AND "program_releases"."released_asset_revision">=0 AND "program_releases"."cache_revision">0

remix_candidates_lifecycle_check.name: remix_candidates_lifecycle_check
remix_candidates_lifecycle_check.value: ("remix_candidates"."status" <> 'applied' OR ("remix_candidates"."applied_at" IS NOT NULL AND "remix_candidates"."applied_by" IS NOT NULL AND "remix_candidates"."applied_revision_id" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("remix_candidates"."status" <> 'rejected' OR ("remix_candidates"."rejected_at" IS NOT NULL AND "remix_candidates"."rejected_by" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("remix_candidates"."status" <> 'stale' OR "remix_candidates"."stale_at" IS NOT NULL)
